status: v2 (22 Nov 2026): clusters, summaries, numbers. Draft: Aditya reviews.
setting: Invented treatments tested in invented clinical trials. Diseases, outcome measures and trial designs are real concepts; drug names, trial names, sponsors and results are invented.

words.source_kinds: clinical trials and the treatments and earlier trials they assess

parts.stem: the real drug-name stem that fits the drug class, e.g. mab, tinib, gliflozin, pril

attrs.summary: an oral once-daily SGLT2 inhibitor that lowers blood glucose by blocking glucose reabsorption in the kidney
adults with type 2 diabetes on metformin, randomised to the drug or placebo; primary outcome a composite of cardiovascular death or hospitalisation for heart failure

finds_benefit.meaning: the trial reports that the treatment improved the main outcome

finds_no_effect.meaning: the trial reports no clear difference on the main outcome for the treatment

finds_harm.meaning: the trial reports that the treatment made the main outcome or safety worse

contradicts.meaning: the trial reports a result that disagrees with an earlier trial

confusable_note: DRAFT for review: a trend that is not significant is often written as a benefit; a safety signal with no difference on the main outcome reads as harm or as no effect.
real_names_note: Real names that invented entities must not use (whole words, any case; world.check). Empty until Aditya approves the sources for this list.

questions.text: Which treatments showed a benefit in {s}?
Which trials found {o} helpful, and which did not?

world_notes: Make 3-4 invented treatments for the cluster's condition and enough trials (years 2012-2025) that each paper has its own mix. A trial may only contradict an EARLIER trial. Plant disagreements: two trials with opposite findings for the same treatment.
cluster_note: All trials and treatments of this cluster are about ONE real condition within the cluster topic: put that condition in every trial's condition attribute and pick a drug class that is really used for it.

effect.name: hazard ratio for the primary outcome
